newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Five babies die in Brazil vaccine mix-up - reports.
newsitem.headline: Five babies die in Brazil vaccine mix-up - reports.

text.p: Five babies died when a nurse mistakenly injected them with insulin instead of a triple vaccine at a clinic in northeastern Brazil, news reports said on Sunday.

Local television and newspaper reports said 32 children received shots of insulin used to treat diabetes instead of vaccine during a vaccination campaign in the town of Santa Maria do Cambuca in the northeastern state of Pernambuco.
The reports could not be independently confirmed early on Sunday. Santa Maria do Cambuca is 120 miles (195 km) west of the state capital of Recife.
Citing local and state health officials, the news reports said the nurse had years of experience but simply confused the small flasks of insulin for vaccine.
"It was a mistake," Arnaldo Lucero Cabral, the town's health secretary, told TV Globo. "This person has 17 years experience in this unit. Unfortunately, a human error occurred."
The nurse had not been charged and police had not opened an investigation into the case, reports said.
